criteria.detail: Sets Status terminal (§1), then drops durable signals as c2m note candidates into the inbox (§2), then removes the plan dir (§3) — order correct.
Treats settled decisions, resolved questions, delegate gotcha, and mid-flight user feedback as candidates, and states run artifacts and repo-derivable restatements are not candidates.
All four notes carry --source plan:<plan-dir> and --tree <project>/.cortex/memory, classified as project knowledge to the project tree per the kit-vs-project rule.
Removes plan dir contents only after candidates sit in the inbox, leaving the directory holding incidents/2026-08-05-ci-libyaml-gotcha.md as survivor.
States the closed list COMPLETE, DONE, CANCELLED, SUPERSEDED, ABANDONED and that a work-reopening qualifier (COMPLETE - INTEGRATION OPEN) is not terminal.
8 c2m note command(s), each with --source plan:2026-08-05-demo-effort and a --tree memory-tree value
no forbidden sources cited, no git output, no forbidden .cortex reads, no file writes

judge_reasoning: The actor satisfies all five criteria: correct close-out ordering, complete signal classification with negatives, provenance and tree flags on every note, incident-surviving removal after inbox landing, and the exact terminal token list with the reopening-qualifier rule.
